verdict.rationale: Skyfire has a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (charge token, introspect token, wallet balance with sample JSON responses), and the quickstart points to a Playground where tokens can be created with pre-filled parameters. That is a runnable path, but the evidence never shows the reference pages themselves having an interactive try-it console, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documented in-reference interactive 'try it' execution, runnable code samples across endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
